html:
SMTO-GML-0065 — SMTO can't change this Gmail setting

GUID: 00dfa7fb-d27b-446f-925c-259426f6fd5c
Slug: gmail-client-setting-invalid
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gmail-client-actions

What happened

  • SMTO can change only a few Gmail settings: the vacation auto-reply, display language, IMAP and POP access, and your main address's name, reply-to address and signature. The setting or value you asked for isn't one of these, so nothing changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to show the current values first, for example: show my Gmail vacation reply settings. Seeing the current values shows which fields can be changed and what kind of value each one takes.
  2. Ask again for a change to one of: vacation auto-reply, display language, IMAP access, POP access, or your main address's display name, reply-to address or signature. These are the only Gmail settings SMTO is allowed to change.
  3. For forwarding, other send-as addresses or anything else, change it in Gmail's own settings on the web. SMTO deliberately doesn't touch settings that control where your mail goes or who it is sent as.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reports the setting as updated and shows the new value.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't change IMAP deletion settings as a way around a problem deleting emails; that affects your whole account.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Gmail settings request named an unsupported setting family, or the update failed the field allowlist or value schema for vacation, language, imap, pop or primary_identity.

What this means

  • The selected setting has an explicit field whitelist. Updates merge only validated changes with currently readable supported values, and never edit another send-as identity or forwarding configuration.

Why this can happen

  • The selected setting has an explicit field whitelist. Updates merge only validated changes with currently readable supported values, and never edit another send-as identity or forwarding configuration.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the selected account, action arguments and operation reference; do not infer mailbox effects from the error alone.

How to fix it

  • Use get_settings to inspect the supported family, then send update_settings with at least one allowlisted field of the correct type (SETTING_FIELDS in gmail/client_actions). Forwarding and non-primary send-as identities are not editable through this action; updates merge with current readable values and are reread for verification.
  • Discover gmail.settings and use fields valid for vacation, language, POP, IMAP or the primary identity.

Retry and execution caution

  • Discover gmail.settings and use fields valid for vacation, language, POP, IMAP or the primary identity.

How to verify the fix

  • Only requested supported fields change; omitted settings are preserved.

What not to do

  • Do not change account-wide deletion settings as a workaround for message deletion.

Technical notes

  • This check rejects new work before its write. It does not undo previous confirmed effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
